# Filter the dataset to find rows where compensation.o and compensation.r are both 'cash'
cash_compensation_studies = df[(df['compensation.o'] == 'cash') & (df['compensation.r'] == 'cash')]

# Check the unique values in the 'project.y' column for these studies
domains_with_cash_compensation = cash_compensation_studies['project.y'].unique()
domains_with_cash_compensation

# Check for studies in 'rpp' and 'ee' domains where compensation is not 'cash' in either original or replication study
non_cash_compensation_studies = df[(df['project.y'].isin(['rpp', 'ee'])) & 
                                   ((df['compensation.o'] != 'cash') | (df['compensation.r'] != 'cash'))]

non_cash_compensation_studies[['study', 'compensation.o', 'compensation.r', 'project.y']]
